report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of subprocess_adapter.py: stream parsing, typed event mapping, lifecycle control, and process teardown; claims focus on error handling and event semantics.
risks: stream() | high | Session timeout errors are raised as TimeoutError, but the docstring/API may promise a different exception type; also terminate() may race with stream()'s while loop after pop. | Check the class docstring and callers for expected exception types; inspect stream()'s loop for session removal handling.

_parse_typed_event | medium | ToolRequested.arguments may be None if 'input'/'arguments' key is absent, despite the constructor possibly expecting a dict; also CommandOutput.exit_code uses int() which can raise ValueError on non-numeric strings. | Confirm ToolRequested constructor accepts None; verify event shapes from providers.

_parse_typed_event | medium | The 'result'/'turn.completed' branch returns AgentMessage with json.dumps() of a dict, while other branches return TextDelta; this inconsistency may surprise consumers. | Check AgentMessage constructor and consumer expectations.

_parse_typed_event | medium | 'message'/'assistant_message'/'response' branch uses 'content' or 'text' but not 'message' field; if the event uses 'message' as a dict, it will serialize to string '{}'. | Verify provider event shapes.

terminate() | medium | terminate() pops the session before awaiting stderr_task, but stream() may still be iterating and will try to publish SessionEnded for a session that is no longer in _sessions; _publish may fail or emit orphan events. | Inspect _publish for handling of missing session.
interrupt() | low | Race: session.process.returncode may be None but process may have just exited; send_signal may raise ProcessLookupError which is caught. | Acceptable; no further action.
_stop_process | low | The 5-second wait timeout is arbitrary; no configurable timeout. | Check if a configurable timeout is needed.

handoff.purpose: Stream session output, parse events, and manage process lifecycle (interrupt/terminate/stop).

symbols.name: stream
symbols.note: Async generator that yields SessionStarted, AgentEvent, and SessionEnded; enforces session timeout and stops the process on timeout or EOF.

symbols.name: _parse_line
symbols.note: Parses a raw line into an AgentEvent; handles text mode, JSON, and fallback to TextDelta.

symbols.name: _parse_typed_event
symbols.note: Maps event type strings to specific AgentEvent subclasses; falls back to a system AgentMessage.

symbols.name: approve
symbols.note: Always raises NotImplementedError; one-shot CLI profiles do not support approval.

symbols.name: reject
symbols.note: Always raises NotImplementedError; one-shot CLI profiles do not support rejection.

symbols.name: interrupt
symbols.note: Sends SIGINT to the session process if it is still running; swallows ProcessLookupError and OSError.

symbols.name: _stop_process
symbols.note: Static helper that terminates a process, waits up to 5 seconds, then kills it; swallows ProcessLookupError and OSError.

symbols.name: terminate
symbols.note: Pops the session and its sequence, stops the process, and waits for the stderr task with a 1-second timeout, canceling if needed.

observations.what: stream() raises TimeoutError, but the class docstring (in chunk 1) may promise a different exception type; the API contract is not verifiable here.
In _parse_typed_event, ToolRequested.arguments can be None if neither 'input' nor 'arguments' is present; the constructor may expect a dict.
CommandOutput.exit_code uses int(data.get('exit_code') or 0) which raises ValueError for non-numeric strings, potentially crashing the stream.
The 'result'/'turn.completed' branch returns AgentMessage with json.dumps() of a dict, while other branches return TextDelta; this inconsistency may surprise consumers.
The 'message'/'assistant_message'/'response' branch does not handle 'message' as a field; if the event uses 'message' as a dict, it will serialize to '{}'.
terminate() pops the session before stream() finishes; stream() may still try to publish SessionEnded for a session no longer in _sessions.
The fallback in _parse_typed_event returns AgentMessage with role='system', but the constructor may not accept a role parameter; this could raise TypeError.
The parser is lenient: unrecognized JSON events are converted to AgentMessage with json.dumps(data), which may silently change shape rather than error.
